description: The chart illustrates the number of hateful communication datasets over time, broken down by researcher location as indicated by the legend titled “Researcher Location.” The horizontal axis lists the categorical variable “Year” in chronological order from 2012 through 2022. The vertical axis is labeled “Number of datasets” and uses a logarithmic scale with major tick marks at approximately \(10^0\) (1), \(10^1\) (10), and \(10^2\) (100), spanning roughly from 1 up to a bit above 100. For each year, multiple narrow bars are grouped side-by-side (not stacked), with colors mapping to locations: Other (dark blue), USA (orange), IN (green), UK (red), IT (purple), and DE (brown). Approximate bar heights by year are: 2012 shows USA at about 2; 2013 shows USA at about 2; 2014 shows Other near 2 and USA near 1; 2015 shows Other near 3 and DE near 1; 2016 shows Other near 4, USA near 7, IN near 3, and UK near 2; 2017 shows Other near 20, USA near 15, IN near 1, UK near 9, and IT near 5; 2018 shows Other near 30, USA near 12, and IN/UK/IT/DE each near 4; 2019 shows Other near 50, USA near 16, IN near 6, UK near 2, and IT near 8; 2020 shows Other near 90, USA near 35, IN near 12, UK near 15, IT near 2, and DE near 20; 2021 shows Other a little above 100 (around 120), USA near 40, IN near 20, UK near 18, IT near 12, and DE near 9; and 2022 shows lighter-tinted bars with Other around 25, USA around 3, IN around 9, UK around 8, and IT around 1 (with no visible DE bar). The bars are not presented as sorted by magnitude within years; they follow a consistent grouped layout per year, and there are no visible annotations or emphasized bars beyond the color coding and the lighter tint used for the final year’s bars.
